titulo_es: Reading: active participles of the past

нему.es: él; forma de dativo tras «по» (según él / por él, según contexto)
нему.en: He; form of dative after «по» (according to him / by him, according to context)

новую.es: nuevo (femenino ruso, acusativo; concuerda con книгу)
новую.en: new (Russian feminine, accusative; agrees with книгу)

её.es: la (acusativo femenino ruso, referido a книгу; en español, «lo» por libro)
её.en: (Russian feminine accusative, referred to книгу; in Spanish, «the» per book)

bloques.titulo: The one who already did something.
texto: Many active participles of the past are formed from the masculine form of the past: **-л** is replaced by **-вш-** and the terminations are added: **прочитал → прочитавший**, **опубликовал → опубликовавший**. They express an action prior to the main verb.
They match the noun: **писатель, опубликовавший роман**; **студенты, прочитавшие книгу**. Some verbs use other formations; learn the frequent ones in context.

frases.ru: Студенты, прочитавшие новую книгу, обсуждали её с преподавателем.
frases.es: Los estudiantes que habían leído el libro nuevo lo comentaban con el profesor.
frases.en: The students who had read the new book discussed it with the teacher.

frases.ru: Писатель, опубликовавший роман в прошлом году, приехал на встречу.
frases.es: El escritor que publicó la novela el año pasado vino al encuentro.
frases.en: The writer who published the novel last year came to meet.

frases.ru: Книги, переведённые на русский язык, лежали на столе.
frases.es: Los libros traducidos al ruso estaban sobre la mesa.
frases.en: The books translated into Russian were on the table.

bloques.pregunta: Who was commenting on the book?

opciones.texto: The students who had read it.
opciones.explicacion: **Студенты, прочитавшие книгу** = the students who had read it.

opciones.texto: The writer who published the novel.
opciones.explicacion: The writer appears in the second sentence.
The teacher talked to the students.

bloques.pregunta: What did the writer do before he came to the meeting?

opciones.texto: I translate the book into Russian.
opciones.explicacion: That's what the books say in the third sentence.
conjugated verb; here you need the participle.

bloques.pregunta: What does the participle express in «Писатель, опубликовавший роман в прошлом году, приехал на встречу»?

opciones.texto: The writer published the novel before he came to the meeting.
The writer is now publishing the novel.
opciones.explicacion: That would be an ongoing action.

opciones.texto: The novel was published by the writer.
opciones.explicacion: That would be a passive way.

intro: Read a brief text and look at the forms that describe the person who made an action before the main verb.
